observations: Photo 0 shows an open silver laptop with the screen on but dark; keyboard, touchpad, and palm rest are visible.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the keyboard and palm rest with stickers for Intel Core i3, Windows 7, and Intel Inside.
No laptop brand or model name is readable in either photo; the top bezel is cut off in photo 1 and the logo area in photo 0 is illegible.
The seller states the battery is bad and every other part is okay.

claims.evidence: Photos cannot show battery health or charge retention.
Photos cannot test keyboard, screen, ports, storage, or other components.

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge
risks.proof: Video of the laptop booting and running on battery power without a charger

risks.risk: Screen may be damaged or not displaying correctly
risks.proof: Video of the screen showing a clear, stable image

risks.risk: Keyboard or individual keys may not function
risks.proof: Video of a typing test across all keys
Video of the touchpad moving the cursor and clicking

risks.risk: Charger or power adapter may be missing or faulty
risks.proof: Photo of the original charger and power cable

risks.risk: Storage drive may be missing or failed
risks.proof: Screenshot of BIOS or disk management showing a detected drive

risks.risk: RAM or processor may differ from the stickers shown
risks.proof: Screenshot of system properties showing installed RAM and processor

proof_requests: Video of the laptop booting and running on battery power
Photo of the charger and power cable
Screenshot of system properties showing RAM and storage
Video of keyboard and touchpad in use
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a laptop by type; even with an unreadable model and unverified condition, it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working unit with a bad battery.
